answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 162020 Country: India Title: Is it sunnah to give charity in form of money or silver or gold equivalent to the weight of a newborn baby hair? Question: Is it sunnah to give charity in form of money or silver or gold equivalent to the weight of a newborn baby hair? Answer ID: 162020 Posted on: May 14, 2023 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1288/1060/L=9/1439) One should give in charity silver or gold equal to the weight of hair of the newborn baby after shaving it off. It is mustahab and the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) has urged for the same. It should be noted that it should be weighed with gold or silver, not with rupees. However it is also correct if money is given in charity in place of gold or silver. عن علي قال : عق رسول الله – صلى الله عليه وسلم – عن الحسن بشاة فقال: "يا فاطمة! احلقي راسه وتصدقي بزنة شعره فضة" فكان وزنه درهما أو بعض درهم. (المصنف لابن أبي شيبه : 5/111 رقم 24224 كتاب العقيقة دارالكتب العلمية بيروت) ويستحب لمن ولد له ولد أن يسميه يوم أسبوعه ويحلق رأسه ويتصدق عند الأئمة الثلاثة بزنة شعره فضة أو ذهباً الخ . (رد المحتار: 9/485، آخر كتاب الأضحية، ط: مكتبة زكريا ديوبند) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
